In case of skin contact: After contact with skin, wash immediately with plenty of water and soap. Take off immediately all contaminated clothing. If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/attention.
After eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
Rinse mouth. Let 1 glass of water be drunken in little sips (dilution effect). Get medical advice/attention if you feel unwell. Self-protection of the first aider:
Use personal protection equipment. No direct artificial respiration to be given by first aider.

8.2.2. Personal protection equipment

kids.content: Eye glasses with side protection EN 166

Skin protection: Tested protective gloves must be worn (EN ISO 374). Take recovery periods for skin regeneration. Breakthrough times and swelling properties of the material must be taken into consideration. Suitable material: NBR (Nitrile rubber), Thickness of the glove material: > 0,35 mm. In the case of wanting to use the gloves again, clean them before taking off and air them well.

Respiratory protection: Usually no personal respirative protection necessary. In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Filtering device with filter or ventilator filtering device of type: ABEK-P3.
Wash hands before breaks and after work.
